title: Add Silenos Música to build
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [Silenos Música](https://www.silenos.es/musica) to build
- Silenos Música conecta con Acestep y Eleven Labs para crear nuevas canciones y sonidos de forma sencilla.

Fixes #12476

gist.headline: Songs join the garden
gist.blurb: Silenos Música has landed in the build: a small doorway from an idea to a new song or sound. Polli brought headphones, naturally.
gist.summary: Added Silenos Música to the app catalog, connecting Acestep and ElevenLabs to make creating songs and sounds simpler.
gist.impact: People browsing the Pollinations build can now discover Silenos Música as a ready-made tool for generating music and audio.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Silenos Música as a cozy music-making garden studio: Polli wears oversized headphones and tends flowering audio waveforms growing from pots beside a retro sampler. Include soft sound notes and a small CRT monitor showing a simple song waveform, representing the Acestep and ElevenLabs-powered music and sound creation workflow.
